The fault therefore depends on the state of the harness process handle table (earlier tests in the same long-lived process leave handles of arbitrary types), not on a documented API contract; PssCaptureSnapshot docs promise no failure mode here. Cause of the AV itself is not explained (UNEXPLAINED Windows behaviour, not claimed as a bug of the test). Fix is construction-only: the handle-capturing scenario runs in a fresh child process (own handle table, no area VEH; the parent harness aborts the whole test on any first-chance 0xC000xxxx, even one handled inside Windows) and the parent requires exit code 0 with identical assertions as before; a genuine unhandled AV in the child still FAILS (exit 0xC0000005 reported). No expectation weakened. UNVERIFIED-until-rerun
